# Blizad

> Blizad is a growth company based in Raipur, Chhattisgarh, India. One team runs performance marketing, SEO, GEO and AEO, full-stack web development and managed hosting for businesses across India. Tagline: Built for momentum.

## People
- Sourav Yadav (also known as Krantiveer), Founder & CEO: seven years in digital marketing; has managed Google, Meta and LinkedIn advertising for 50+ brands.
- Vidit Vaibhav, Co-founder & CTO: full-stack engineer with experience on products for Google and Thomson Reuters (as clients); certified Claude practitioner; built TuneFry, My Life Choices and SCDM Accelerator.

## Work
- [TuneFry](https://www.tunefry.com/home): music distribution platform for independent artists.
- [My Life Choices](https://www.my-lifechoices.com/): personalised wellness marketplace with bookings and a books store.
- [SCDM Accelerator](https://scdm-accelerator.org/): hackathon platform for industry and academia in clinical data.
